facts.value: The Results workspace has static storage duration and is reset on scene entry. Entry borrows the incoming completed-match record, configures two pages for No Contest or Retry and three otherwise, and starts all players on page 2 only for uncanceled match kind 3. During interaction, page and scroll state determine navigation availability, and rebuilding replaces the player's prior three-by-ten statistics-text set. The separate per-player descriptor array is initialized independently rather than included in the workspace reset.
facts.rationale: Corrects the storage-lifetime claim and the missing cancellation qualification while preserving supported reset and interaction behavior.

evidence.why: Reset, borrowed binding, nested page branch, and descriptor initialization.

facts.value: Requests hierarchy animation frame zero, selects the character- or canceled-outcome variant, and temporarily sets its material animation to frame `1 + color_index` at rate zero before evaluating the material. It restores material frame zero and rate one, then stops FObj animation types 4, 5, and 6 through `mn_8022F3D8` using `MOBJ_MASK`; those three numbers are type selectors, not masks. Finally it registers `fn_80176BCC` at process priority 0 and constructs placement models from four extracted child translations. The selected variant is dereferenced without a NULL check.
facts.rationale: Corrects the interpretation of the three animation-helper arguments and preserves the exact initialization sequence and unchecked selected-child lifetime.

evidence.why: Frame/rate sequence, helper arguments, callback registration, and placement handoff.
Helper matches FObj obj_type and stops matching animations under the supplied mask.

facts.value: Configures two pages for No Contest or Retry and three otherwise; only the uncanceled match-kind-3 path starts every player on page 2. When `fn_801701B8()` returns zero, entry processes each slot's bonuses and assigns `count * 2 + 2` to that slot's byte-sized mode-2 descriptor count; otherwise it sets those counts to zero without scanning bonuses. These are counts, not scroll offsets, and the assignment narrows to u8. The human representative, cancellation state, and x3_6 flag gate the result effect; cancellation separately gates victory music. Fighter and camera creation skips unavailable standings.
facts.rationale: Replaces the incorrect statistic-offset interpretation and makes the scan bypass and byte-sized count explicit without assuming a safe award-count bound.

evidence.why: Page configuration, conditional bonus processing, effect/music guards, and occupied-slot construction.

facts.value: The unit configures two Results pages for No Contest or Retry and three for other outcomes. All players start on page 2 only when the outcome is uncanceled and match kind is 3; canceled kind-3 results retain the reset page value. Per-player secondary text setup dispatches on match kind: 2 directly renders a bounded numeric statistic, 1 selects the KO-time renderer, 3 selects the extended signed-score renderer, and all other values select the ordinary signed-score renderer.
facts.rationale: Corrects the unconditional kind-3 initial-page claim while retaining the supported four-way numeric dispatch.

evidence.why: Reset followed by cancellation-qualified initial-page assignment.
